project.name: InnerOS Ambient Guardian
project.summary: A local-first Alexa+ guardian using official MCP, AWS Strands and local Qwen to understand property context, prepare bounded actions, require human approval, verify outcomes, and return evidence.
project.ai_usage: Local Qwen/vLLM reasoning plus AWS Strands read-only orchestration; deterministic policy controls action authorization and verification.
project.codex_usage: Built, debugged, tested, hardened, documented, and validated the official MCP/Strands implementation with CI and real runtime smokes.
